title: battery
description: v0.2 device-model entity: a battery bank as seen by a shunt, BMS, or inverter-charger, regardless of vendor. Published under renewvan/battery/<id>/<property>. The four core measurements are required of every source; everything else is optional because not every source can supply it (a shunt has no charge stage, a BMS-less lead-acid bank has no temperature probe). Consumers MUST tolerate absent optional properties.

temperature_c.description: Optional: only sources with a temperature probe publish it.

time_to_go_s.description: Optional: estimated seconds until empty at the present discharge rate. Absent while charging or idle (no meaningful estimate).

time_since_full_charge_s.description: Optional: seconds since the bank was last fully charged, as tracked by the source.

charge_state.description: Optional: charge stage of the system that is charging this bank. Only sources that know the stage publish it (e.g. an aggregated charger/system state); a plain shunt does not. `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback for any code not in this enum.
